{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overestimation bias.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent 3-5 day true outcomes show mean reversion toward lower levels.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if model shows sharp upward spikes (e.g., >15% above recent high) without sentiment support.",
    "Apply upward bias correction if sentiment > 0.25 and model forecast is below true outcome by >10% — indicate bullish momentum.",
    "Cap forecast growth after 3 consecutive days of upward spikes to prevent overshoot and volatility overcorrection.",
    "Use 15-day moving average of true outcomes as baseline for correction if model deviates >15% from recent history.",
    "If sentiment is positive (≥ 0.25) and model underperforms, increase forecast by 5-10% to align with sentiment-driven momentum.",
    "Apply downward correction if model consistently overestimates true outcomes in 3 consecutive days — indicate model overconfidence."
  ]
}
